name: Multi-Entity Finance Leader
description: CFO or controller running finance for a company with multiple entities, subsidiaries, or locations who needs one consolidated view instead of stitching together spreadsheets.

name: QuickBooks Upgrader
description: Finance lead who has outgrown QuickBooks Online or Desktop and is evaluating an ERP step-up, wanting a fast, low-disruption migration rather than a rebuild.
priorities: keep existing Chart of Accounts and lists

name: Construction & Field Services Controller
description: Controller at a project-based construction, field-services, or trades business (the site's most common named customer segment) weighing Intuit Enterprise Suite against other mid-market ERPs.

name: Accountant / ProAdvisor
description: Accounting firm or ProAdvisor helping clients evaluate and migrate to Intuit Enterprise Suite, motivated by preferred pricing and hands-on migration support.
priorities: professional services support for client migrations
an open ecosystem of apps clients already use

name: Nonprofit & Professional Services Finance Director
description: Finance director at a nonprofit or professional-services organization managing multiple locations, grants, or programs, prioritizing governance, compliance, and audit-readiness over deal pricing.
priorities: audit-ready controls and complete approval history
consolidated reporting across programs or locations
